1977 年 9 月 5 日，旅行者 1 号启程。它比 2 号晚出发，却将率先抵: On September 5, 1977, Voyager 1 set off. It launched after Voyager 2, but would reach Jupiter first.
1977 年 8 月 20 日，旅行者 2 号先行出发。一场跨越四颗巨行星的远行: On August 20, 1977, Voyager 2 left Earth first. A journey past four giant planets had begun.
发动机不会一直推着它。飞船沿引力塑造的轨道滑行，借行星的运动改变方向与日心速度。: Gravity carries it onward. Moving planets redirect it and change its speed relative to the Sun.
木星的云带铺满视野。木卫一的火山，让人类第一次看见地球之外正在喷发的火山。: Jupiter's cloud bands fill the view. Io's volcanoes reveal the first active volcanic eruptions ever seen beyond Earth.
四个月后，2 号抵达木星。木卫二交错的冰纹，留下一个后来不断被追问的海洋世界之谜: Four months later, Voyager 2 reaches Jupiter. Europa’s fractured ice hints at an ocean world.
为一颗卫星改变去向: Choosing a moon, changing a route
下一站是土星。为了接近包裹在浓雾中的土卫六，1 号将放弃继续飞向天王星和海王星。: Next, Saturn: a close pass of hazy Titan costs Voyager 1 an onward route to Uranus and Neptune.
两艘飞船的道路从这里分开：1 号的土卫六飞掠把它送向黄道面以北。: The two routes diverge here: Voyager 1's Titan encounter sends it north of the ecliptic plane.
飞船掠过浓厚的大气，却看不穿橙色的雾霾。一个世界的答案，被留给了下一代探测器。: It passes thick orange haze but cannot see through. The answers await another generation.
土星在身后转成弯月。1 号离开行星密集的平面，此后再也没有近距离拜访过一颗行星。: Saturn recedes as a crescent. Voyager 1 leaves the planetary plane, never to visit another planet.
1990 年 2 月 14 日，旅行者 1 号回望太阳系。地球落在一道杂散光里，: On 14 February 1990, Voyager 1 looks back. Earth is less than a pixel in scattered sunlight.
1 号已经转向北方。2 号继续沿着巨行星之间的窄小窗口，赶往下一次引力助推。: Voyager 1 turns north; Voyager 2 threads the giant planets’ narrow windows toward its next gravity assist.
穿过光环的阴影: Past the shadows of the rings
2 号在土星近旁转弯，朝天王星远去。精细的环纹和冰卫星，改变了人们对这颗行星的认: Voyager 2 turns at Saturn toward Uranus. Detailed rings and icy moons transform our view of Saturn.
两次飞掠之间，是漫长的黑暗。这里快进的是时间，太阳系的距离没有被压缩。: Between flybys lies a long darkness. Time speeds up; distances remain to scale.
横躺着的冰巨星: The ice giant on its side
1986 年 1 月，2 号抵达天王星。近乎横躺的自转轴，让这个遥远世界有了极端: January 1986: Voyager 2 reaches Uranus. Its sideways spin brings extreme seasons.
再走三年半。阳光越来越弱，地球发来的指令需要数小时才能抵达。: Another three and a half years. Sunlight grows fainter, and a command from Earth takes hours to arrive.
1989 年 8 月，2 号从海王星上空掠过。巨大的风暴、细环与云影，从模糊的光: August 1989: Voyager 2 passes Neptune. A faint point becomes storms, rings and clouds.
最后一次近距离相遇留给海卫一。喷流与年轻的地表，说明遥远而寒冷并不意味着死寂。: One last flyby: Triton. Plumes and young terrain reveal activity in a cold, distant world.
2012 年 8 月 25 日，1 号穿过日球层顶，进入星际空间。太阳的引力影响: On August 25, 2012, Voyager 1 crosses the heliopause into interstellar space. It remains under the Sun's gravitational influence.
2018 年 11 月 5 日，2 号也穿过日球层顶。两条不同方向的航线，测量着: November 5, 2018: Voyager 2 crosses the heliopause. Two routes probe the solar wind bubble’s boundary.
距离已经以百个天文单位计。我们看见的，是一个逐渐远去的坐标，也是几代人接力守护的: Hundreds of AU away, a receding point carries generations of human work.
约四万年后，1 号预计从恒星 Gliese 445 约 1.6 光年之外经过。经: In about 40,000 years, Voyager 1 may pass 1.6 light-years from Gliese 445. Passing nearby is not arriving.
约四万年后，2 号预计从恒星 Ross 248 约 1.7 光年之外经过。它没有: In about 40,000 years, Voyager 2 may pass 1.7 light-years from Ross 248. It is not navigating to a star.
旅行者 1 号拍摄。木卫一与木卫二出现在木星前方；滤镜影像合成。: Voyager 1 image of Io and Europa in front of Jupiter, combined from filtered exposures.
旅行者 2 号拍摄的木卫二彩色合成影像。交错的线纹遍布冰面。: A Voyager 2 colour composite of Europa. Intersecting markings cover its icy surface.
旅行者 1 号影像，经过增强处理，以突出厚重的雾霾层。: A Voyager 1 image enhanced to reveal the thick haze layer.
旅行者 1 号在最近接近四天后回望土星。行星的阴影落在光环上。: Voyager 1 looks back four days after closest approach. Saturn casts its shadow across the rings.
旅行者 2 号接近土星时的影像；增强色彩用于突出云带细节。: Voyager 2 approaching Saturn; enhanced colours emphasize atmospheric structure.
旅行者 2 号的天王星影像。颜色来自滤镜合成，并非肉眼观测的直接记录。: A Voyager 2 image of Uranus. Filter composites are not a direct record of naked-eye colour.
旅行者 2 号拍摄的海卫一假彩色影像，突出明亮南半球的斑驳地貌。: A false-colour Voyager 2 image highlighting mottled terrain in Triton's bright southern hemisphere.
各携一张镀金唱片，留下地球的声音、问候与图像。镜头从入轨后开始。: Each carries a Golden Record of Earth’s sounds, greetings and images. This view begins after launch.
行星排列提供了难得的航行窗口。定位圆点经过放大。: The planetary alignment opened a rare launch window. Position markers are enlarged.
切换飞船视角，看行星占据多大的天空。: Switch to the spacecraft view to see the planet’s apparent size.
雾霾球面是示意；历史照片另列。: The hazy sphere is illustrative; the archive photo is shown separately.
航线向黄道面以北弯折。球面和环的姿态为示意。: The trajectory bends north of the ecliptic. Surface and ring orientations are illustrative.
任务逐次延长，两颗行星的旅程终于变成四颗。: Successive mission extensions turned a two-planet journey into four.
暂停，看两次相遇之间的空白。: Pause to take in the space between encounters.
米兰达破碎般的地形，也在此时第一次被近距离看见。: Miranda’s fractured-looking terrain was also seen close up for the first time.
单程光时由地球与飞船的几何距离估算。: One-way light time is estimated from the geometric Earth–spacecraft distance.
视直径来自真实尺寸和距离；相机指向为示意。: Apparent size follows physical size and distance; camera pointing is illustrative.
参考圈表示太阳风边界的尺度，不是固定球面或引力边界。: The reference ring illustrates the solar-wind boundary’s scale, not a fixed sphere or gravitational boundary.
轨道冻结于 2026-09-18，含预测段；非实时遥测。: Tracks are frozen at 2026-09-18 and include predictions, not live telemetry.
匀速外推忽略太阳、银河与恒星引力。相遇估计另引 NASA，不能用此线预测亿年去向: Straight-line extrapolation omits gravity. NASA encounter estimates are separate; this line cannot predict billion-year destinations. The Oort Cloud is inferred.
NASA 档案轨道插值，未来简化外推。标记、光照与星空为示意；球面不复原历史相机: Interpolated NASA tracks; future extrapolation. Markers, lighting and stars are schematic; surfaces are not historical camera views.
“暗淡蓝点”为滤镜合成。此后相机关闭；更远处画面均为重建。: Pale Blue Dot combines filtered exposures. The cameras then shut down; later views are reconstructions.
彗核为近似球形；彗尾仅示意背离太阳的方向。: Approximate spherical nucleus; the tail only illustrates the anti-solar direction.
采用各来源历元的二体近似，省略摄动和喷气。: Two-body elements at each source epoch; perturbations and outgassing omitted.
固定 J2000 根数；地球近似为地月质心。省略摄动、食、岁差与极轴方位。: Fixed J2000 elements; Earth–Moon barycentre as Earth. No perturbations, eclipses, precession or pole azimuth.
奥尔特云尚未直接观测，点云为推测示意；日球层顶并非固定球面。: The Oort Cloud is inferred, not directly observed; points are schematic. The heliopause is not a fixed sphere.
1990 年数据的 2020 年重处理版。地球不足一像素；亮带为杂散阳光。: 2020 reprocessing of 1990 exposures. Earth is sub-pixel; the bright band is scattered sunlight.
2 号影像合成，增强了对比度与蓝色，非肉眼颜色。: Voyager 2 composite with enhanced contrast and blue colour, not a naked-eye view.
最近接近后，扫描平台卡滞；工程师调整后恢复观测。: After closest approach, the scan platform jammed. Engineers restored observations.
海卫一逆行公转。飞掠后，2 号向黄道面以南离开。: Triton orbits retrograde. After the flyby, Voyager 2 departs south of the ecliptic.
已知唯一有生命的行星，液态水覆盖约 71% 表面。: The only known planet with life; liquid water covers about 71% of its surface.
最热的行星，表面约 464°C。自转比公转慢；太阳日约 117 个地球日。: The hottest planet, about 464°C. Rotation takes longer than its year; a solar day is about 117 Earth days.
轴倾角约 98°，近乎侧躺；成因仍在研究。甲烷使它呈淡青色。: Tilted about 98°, almost on its side; the cause is still studied. Methane gives it a pale cyan colour.
太阳固定于原点；光球、黑子与辉光为示意，非实时影像。: Fixed Sun; illustrated surface, not live imagery.
